cases.element: task.hints[0].targets: ["object-pron.lo-la/written-form"] for the gloss «la cartera» — «гаманець».

cases.element: task.options[id=b].feedbackUk: «з тильдою» and «без тильди»; task.options[id=c].feedbackUk: «з тильдою».
cases.defect: The feedback incorrectly calls the Spanish written accent a Ukrainian «тильда».
cases.correction: Use «зі знаком наголосу» and «без знака наголосу». The answer key itself is correct.
sources: Course contract rule 8, including content rule 6a, supplied in the prompt.

cases.element: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text: «Назви днів тижня в іспанській завжди пишуться з великої літери, як в англійській: Lunes, Martes, Jueves.»; task.hints[0].targets.
cases.defect: Spanish weekday names normally begin with lowercase letters. Also, capitalization guidance does not explain the assessed appointment-day meaning.
cases.correction: Remove the hint or teach normal lowercase spelling: lunes, martes, jueves. Do not attribute a capitalization-only hint to this reading-meaning target.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), chapter on capitalization, treatment of weekdays, months and seasons (from memory).
Course contract rule 6.

cases.element: clips[0].translationUk and task.hints[0].blocks[0].text: «Зустрічаємося завтра через пів дня біля входу до музею.»
cases.defect: «A mediodía» means at noon, whereas «через пів дня» expresses an elapsed half-day interval.
cases.correction: Replace both translations with «Зустрічаємося завтра опівдні біля входу до музею.»
sources: Packet clips[0].transcript: «Quedamos mañana a mediodía en la puerta del museo.»
RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entry «mediodía» (from memory).

cases.reviewerAnswer: Sentaos for informal vosotros address, or Siéntense for formal ustedes address. Both fit the unspecified relationship to the guests.
cases.element: task.prompt[0].text: «До вас щойно прийшли гості. Запросіть їх сісти (sentarse).»; task.accepted and task.errors[id=e1] select Siéntense and reject Sentaos.
cases.defect: Being guests does not determine formal versus informal plural address in Spain. The packet does not establish which address is intended.
cases.correction: Specify vosotros or ustedes, or explicitly establish the relationship and register. Otherwise allow both readings.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entries «usted» and «vosotros, -tras», addressing distinctions (from memory).
The prompt's verdict definition for underdetermined readings.

cases.element: task.hints[0].blocks[0].text: «якщо основа дієслова закінчується на голосний, дієприкметник на -ido завжди пишеться з тильдою над í» and «construído, incluído»; task.errors[id=e1].feedbackUk: «Потрібна тильда над í».
cases.defect: The rule overgeneralizes: construido and incluido have no written accent. The Ukrainian terminology also incorrectly calls the acute accent a tilde.
cases.correction: Limit the explanation to the taught forms leído, oído and traído and their stressed-í hiatus. If retaining the additional examples, write construido and incluido. Use «знак наголосу».
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), rules for accentuation of diphthongs and hiatus, including ui sequences (from memory).
Course contract rule 8, including content rule 6a.
Packet clips[0].transcript: «Ayer tarde estuve en casa de mis abuelos.»

cases.element: task.accepted[id=v2]: «Se las»; its noteUk: «множину «vecinos» можна перенести на займенник».
cases.defect: La replaces the singular direct object la llave. The plural indirect recipient does not license las in standard Spain Spanish; se replaces les without carrying its number onto the direct-object pronoun.
cases.correction: Remove Se las from accepted answers and correct the note. Accept Se la.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «se», replacement of le/les before direct-object clitics (from memory).
Course contract rule 3.

cases.reviewerAnswer: ¿Ya habéis comido?, ¿Ya ha comido? or ¿Ya han comido?, depending on the addressee; final ya is also possible.
cases.element: task.prompt[0].text: «Перекладіть іспанською: «Ви вже поїли?»»; task.accepted contains only habéis variants.
cases.defect: Ukrainian «Ви» can denote informal plural, formal singular or formal plural address. Initial capitalization does not resolve that ambiguity.
cases.correction: Specify the number and register of the addressee, or accept the corresponding ha, habéis and han variants.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «usted», singular/plural address and third-person agreement (from memory).
The prompt's verdict definition for underdetermined readings.

cases.element: task.errors[id=e1]: «Iros»; feedbackUk: ««Iros» — помилка: це інфінітив із займенником, а не наказовий спосіб.»; task.accepted excludes Iros.
cases.defect: Iros is admitted as a vosotros imperative of irse. Calling it categorically incorrect and rejecting it is unjustified.
cases.correction: Accept both Idos and Iros. Explain that Idos is the traditional recommended form and Iros is also admitted.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «ir(se)», imperative forms idos/iros (from memory).
FundéuRAE, recommendation on idos and iros as valid forms (from memory).
Course contract rule 3.

cases.reviewerAnswer: a or b: trabajaba for background or habitual description; trabajó for completed employment viewed as a whole.
cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «Mi abuelo ___ en una fábrica de muebles de Valencia.»; task.options[id=b] rejects trabajó.
cases.defect: The sentence supplies no temporal or narrative context establishing a habitual/background reading rather than a completed biographical fact.
cases.correction: Specify the intended viewpoint or provide sufficient narrative context. Otherwise accept both readings and remove the categorical rejection of trabajó.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, treatment of imperfecto versus pretérito perfecto simple under tense and aspect (from memory).

cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «Vosotros ___ muy bien español.»; task.errors[id=e1].feedbackUk: «Потрібна тильда: «habláis».»
cases.defect: The task assesses vosotros and its -áis ending before they have been introduced. The feedback also uses the wrong Ukrainian term for the written accent.
cases.correction: Use a taught person or first teach vosotros and its ending. Replace «тильда» with «знак наголосу».
sources: Course contract rule 1.
Packet context.taughtBefore explicitly limits the introduced persons to yo, tú and él/ella/usted.

cases.element: task.accepted[id=v1], task.referenceAnswer and task.feedback.incorrectUk: «vió»; task.errors[id=e1] rejects «vio»; task.hints[0] includes «vió» and a universal third-person accent rule; feedback and hint use «тильду».
cases.defect: Vio is an orthographic monosyllable and has no written accent. The key reverses correct and incorrect spelling, the explanation overgeneralizes, and the Ukrainian accent terminology is wrong.
cases.correction: Accept vio and reject vió. Explain that third-person stress does not automatically require an accent and that vio is a monosyllable without one. Use «знак наголосу».
sources: RAE/ASALE, Ortografía de la lengua española (2010), accentuation of monosyllables, including vio, dio and fue (from memory).
Course contract rules 3 and 8.

cases.element: task.options[id=b].feedbackUk: «Ця слово жіночого роду».
cases.defect: The feminine demonstrative ця does not agree with the Ukrainian neuter noun слово.
cases.correction: Write «Це слово жіночого роду, тому потрібен артикль «la».»
sources: Ukrainian academic explanatory dictionary, Словник української мови, entry «слово», neuter gender (from memory).

cases.element: task.accepted: «3,02», «3.02»; task.referenceAnswer: «3,02».

cases.reviewerAnswer: For an intended yo subject, he llamado or llamé, depending on the temporal frame. The subject is also unspecified.
cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «Por la mañana ___ a mi hermana.»; task.accepted allows only «he llamado» and task.errors[id=e1] rejects «llamé».
cases.defect: Por la mañana does not identify the day, the current time or the intended temporal viewpoint. Nothing explicitly fixes the subject as yo either.
cases.correction: Specify the subject and the relevant temporal frame and viewpoint. Otherwise do not categorically reject llamé or other contextually appropriate person forms.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, treatment of pretérito perfecto compuesto versus pretérito perfecto simple and temporal anchoring (from memory).

cases.correction: Write «Питальне слово «dónde» пишеться зі знаком наголосу.»

cases.reviewerAnswer: a or b; le can refer to Pablo or Professor Ruiz.
cases.element: task.prompt[0].text: «Ana, Pablo y el profesor Ruiz están en la biblioteca. Ana le da un diccionario.»; task.options[id=a] and [id=b] assign a unique referent.
cases.defect: Both Pablo and Professor Ruiz are compatible singular recipients. The text does not identify which one le denotes.
cases.correction: Name the recipient or add an unambiguous preceding context. Do not infer the professor solely from the order of mention.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «pronombres personales átonos», third-person indirect-object forms le/les (from memory).

cases.reviewerAnswer: A ver. is the intended formula in the transcript; isolated speech is also compatible with the homophonous Haber.
cases.element: clips[0].transcript: «A ver.»; task.prompt: «Прослухайте й запишіть те, що почули.»; task.closed: true with only «A ver.» accepted.
cases.defect: The learner receives an isolated homophonous sequence without semantic context distinguishing a ver from haber. The supplied transcript establishes authorial intent, but the unavailable audio cannot establish sufficient disambiguation.
cases.correction: Provide a contextual recording or a semantic cue establishing the formula's meaning, then review the closed key against that context.
sources: RAE, Español al día, «A ver / haber», distinction between the homophonous expressions (from memory).
The prompt's verdict definition for uncertainty requiring unavailable audio or context.

cases.element: task.prompt[1].text: «El lunes (yo) ___ (ir) al dentista.»; task.targets: «indefinido.regular-ar»; task.hints[0] gives regular -ar endings; task.errors[id=e1].feedbackUk: «Без тильди».
cases.defect: The required irregular past of ir has not been taught and does not assess the declared regular -ar target. The regular-ending hint cannot produce fui. The feedback also misnames the written accent.
cases.correction: Use a taught regular -ar verb, or teach the irregular past of ir and retarget the task and help. Replace the accent terminology with «знак наголосу».
sources: Course contract rules 1 and 8.
Packet context.taughtBefore lists present forms and regular -ar indefinido endings, but not the indefinido of ir.

sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «hora», expression of hours in twelve-hour and twenty-four-hour systems (from memory).

cases.element: clips[0].transcript: «—Busco a Marta y a Lucía. —La llamo ahora mismo.»; task.options[id=b].feedbackUk: «Ні, «la» — це Марта.»

cases.element: task.accepted and task.referenceAnswer: «mi»; task.errors[id=e1] rejects «mí» with «Тильда не потрібна: односкладові слова в іспанській пишуться без тильди.»
cases.defect: The prepositional personal pronoun is mí; mi is the possessive. The rule ignores diacritic accents on monosyllables and uses incorrect Ukrainian terminology.
cases.correction: Accept mí and reject mi. Explain the diacritic distinction and use «знак наголосу». Update the reference answer and feedback.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «mí», distinction from possessive mi (from memory).

cases.element: task.accepted[id=v2]: «habían»; noteUk: «Теж правильно: дієслово узгоджується з «muchas personas».»
cases.defect: Existential haber is impersonal and remains singular in standard Spanish. The plural following it does not license habían here.
cases.correction: Remove habían from accepted answers and replace the note with an explanation of impersonal singular había.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «haber», impersonal existential use and singular agreement (from memory).

cases.element: task.errors[id=e1]: «freído»; feedbackUk: «Форма «freído» неправильна: дієслово freír має лише дієприкметник «frito».»; task.accepted excludes freído.
cases.defect: Freír has two valid participles, frito and freído, both usable with haber. The closed key rejects a correct answer and teaches a false rule.
cases.correction: Accept both frito and freído, remove freído from the error list, and explain that both are valid in compound tenses.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «freír», regular and irregular participles (from memory).
